# Guarantees & capabilities ledger

Every guarantee Sandloom promises and every capability a user can rely on, with the
tests, `sandloom check` rules and import contracts that prove it. The ledger
(`guarantees.yml`) is a CI gate (`tests/architecture/test_guarantee_ledger.py`): an enforcing test that
disappears, an entry deleted without a `removed:` record, or a new ADR section
without an entry fails the build.

**429 guarantees, 170 capabilities, 37 recorded gaps.**

Run exactly the enforcing tests (from the repository root):

```bash
uv run pytest -m guarantees src
```

| <span class="sl-id">G-RLS-01</span> | On a tenant_rls database, every SQL path from the app role (ORM, Core via session/connection, text(), exec_driver_sql, streaming cursors, run_sync, executemany/insertmanyvalues, savepoints) sees and changes only rows of the tenant in sandloom.tenant_id, and an INSERT/UPDATE for another tenant is refused by WITH CHECK. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls.py::test_raw_text_sees_only_bound_tenant`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls.py::test_with_check_blocks_cross_tenant_writes`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls_paths.py::test_cross_tenant_insert_rejected_on_every_path`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls_paths.py::test_update_and_delete_see_only_bound_tenant` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RLS-02</span> | An unset, empty or malformed (not canonical lowercase UUID) sandloom.tenant_id yields zero rows and refused writes on an RLS table, never a cast error or fail-open, including when no engine hook is installed. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls_bypass.py::test_malformed_tenant_setting_fails_closed`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls_paths.py::test_no_tenant_fails_closed_for_every_operation`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls.py::test_policy_without_engine_hook_fails_closed`<br>`tests/perf_budgets/test_rls_merged_begin.py::test_malformed_tenant_in_context_sends_nothing` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RLS-03</span> | The RLS policy has no bypass: neither unscoped() nor the legacy sandloom.tenant_bypass setting lets the app role read or write another tenant's rows. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls_bypass.py::test_bypass_setting_cannot_read_other_tenants`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls_bypass.py::test_bypass_setting_cannot_write_other_tenants`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls_bypass.py::test_unscoped_never_reaches_other_tenants_on_app_role`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls_paths.py::test_legacy_bypass_setting_is_inert_on_every_path` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RLS-04</span> | sandloom.tenant_id is transaction-local and re-synced by the engine hook: it follows a tenant switch within a transaction, is restored after a savepoint rollback, and never carries one pooled transaction's tenant into the next. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls.py::test_settings_do_not_leak_across_pooled_transactions`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls.py::test_settings_resync_within_one_transaction`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls.py::test_savepoint_rollback_forces_resync`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls_bypass.py::test_crud_is_tenant_scoped_and_pool_reuse_does_not_leak` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RLS-05</span> | Startup refuses (TenantRLSConfigError, in every environment, aborting aopen_all and Celery worker boot) a tenant_rls database whose application role is a superuser, has BYPASSRLS, is a member of such a role, owns an RLS table directly or by membership, or is covered by an unconditional (system-role) policy. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls_bypass.py::test_verification_refuses_superuser_app_role`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls_bypass.py::test_verification_refuses_owner_and_member`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls_bypass.py::test_verification_failure_aborts_startup_in_every_environment`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_worker.py::test_worker_boot_runs_tenant_rls_role_verification`<br>**gap (S)**: The BYPASSRLS-attribute branch (and membership in a BYPASSRLS/superuser role) has no direct test; only SUPERUSER, table ownership and system-role membership are exercised. |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RLS-06</span> | The role check cannot be switched off: the former verify_roles database option is refused at startup, and a hardened NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS role passes. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls_bypass.py::test_removed_verify_roles_option_is_refused`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls_bypass.py::test_verification_accepts_hardened_roles` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RLS-07</span> | enable_tenant_rls(op, table) emits (through the Alembic op) ENABLE + FORCE row level security and the <table>_tenant_isolation policy, is idempotent, and disable_tenant_rls reverts it; the tenant setting SQL is parameterised. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls.py::test_migration_helper_emits_policy_through_op`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls.py::test_disable_reverts_policy`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls.py::test_install_is_idempotent_and_postgres_only`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls.py::test_set_config_sql_is_parameterised` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RLS-08</span> | The system channel (system_session) reaches other tenants only on tables migrated with enable_tenant_rls(..., system_access=True), stays tenant-scoped on every other RLS table, honours an explicit tenant_id, rolls back on error, and writes an sandloom.system_db.session audit row with actor and reason in the same transaction. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls_bypass.py::test_system_channel_reaches_all_tenants_and_is_audited`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls_bypass.py::test_system_session_tenant_scoped_and_rollback`<br>**gap (S)**: 'No audit row, no commit' (a failing audit write aborts the system session's commit) and the structured start/end log record (op_id, outcome, duration) are not tested. |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RLS-09</span> | system_session refuses (SystemSessionRefused) an empty actor or a too-short reason and raises SystemChannelUnavailable for a database with no system channel; require_system_channel without a system DSN, or a system_url without tenant_rls, fails at provider construction. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls_bypass.py::test_system_session_requires_actor_reason_and_configuration`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls_bypass.py::test_require_system_channel_without_dsn_fails_fast` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RLS-10</span> | Business-module code has no path to the system channel: sandloom.core.drivers (system_db) and sandloom.core.sql_alchemy.tenant_rls are forbidden infra imports, absent from the public core API, and the database provider exposes no system engine; the app role cannot SET ROLE to the system role. | `tests/architecture/test_system_channel_unreachable.py::test_module_import_of_system_channel_is_flagged`<br>`tests/architecture/test_system_channel_unreachable.py::test_system_channel_not_in_public_core_api`<br>`tests/architecture/test_system_channel_unreachable.py::test_provider_does_not_expose_system_engine`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls_bypass.py::test_app_role_cannot_assume_system_role`<br>rule `infra-imports` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RLS-11</span> | A raw asyncpg driver connection bypasses the RLS hook but runs under the transaction's last synced setting, so with no tenant it fails closed (zero rows). | `sandloom/core/tests/test_tenant_rls_paths.py::test_raw_driver_connection_is_not_covered_but_fails_closed` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RLS-12</span> | The in-process contract pool installs the RLS hook too, so contract_session() statements are scoped by sandloom.tenant_id on a tenant_rls database (also when tenant_rls is requested after the default contract engine exists). | `sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_pool.py::test_default_contract_engine_honours_a_later_tenant_rls_request` |

| <span class="sl-id">G-EFFECT-01</span> | on_commit callbacks run only after the UoW commits, never on rollback, never twice; a failing callback is logged and never fails the committed request; outside a UoW the callback runs at once. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_on_commit.py::test_runs_after_commit_only`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_on_commit.py::test_rollback_never_runs`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_on_commit.py::test_failing_callback_does_not_fail_commit`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_on_commit.py::test_outside_uow_runs_immediately` |

| <span class="sl-id">G-EFFECT-03</span> | before_commit checks run after the handler, in registration order, right before COMMIT; the first failing check rolls the UoW back and propagates; outside a UoW the check runs at once; the testing run_on_commit seam runs before_commit checks first. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_before_commit.py::test_checks_run_in_order_after_the_handler_and_before_commit`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_before_commit.py::test_a_failing_check_rolls_back_instead_of_committing`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_before_commit.py::test_outside_a_unit_of_work_the_check_runs_at_once`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_before_commit.py::test_testing_run_on_commit_runs_the_before_commit_checks_first`<br>**gap (S)**: No test proves that a before_commit check registered inside a rolled-back savepoint is skipped (ADR §3 stage 1). |
| <span class="sl-id">G-EFFECT-04</span> | All durable dedupe stores (consumer_inbox, contract_command_log, http_idempotency_log) are adapters of one relational claim implementation (sandloom.core.sql_alchemy.dedupe_log): a claim is decided by the in-flight transaction, a rolled-back claim leaves no record, the claim never flushes the caller's pending objects, and the bounded purge removes only due records. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_dedupe_record_adapters.py::test_every_store_is_an_adapter_of_one_dedupe_log`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_dedupe_record_adapters.py::test_rolled_back_claim_leaves_no_record`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_dedupe_record_adapters.py::test_concurrent_claim_is_decided_by_the_in_flight_transaction`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_dedupe_record_adapters.py::test_claim_never_flushes_the_callers_pending_objects` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-EFFECT-05</span> | Every replay record shares one set of bounds from sandloom.core.effects / replay_limits: replayed body/result at most 256 KiB (larger -> non-replayable marker, never re-run) and a 24 h default TTL; argument digests are canonical. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_dedupe_record_adapters.py::test_tag_and_ttl_and_replay_bounds`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_dedupe_record_adapters.py::test_replay_outcome_caps_and_refuses_unencodable`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_dedupe_record_adapters.py::test_args_digest_is_canonical_with_a_repr_fallback`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_replay_limits.py::test_replay_body_caps_share_one_bound` |

| <span class="sl-id">G-IDEM-06</span> | Idempotency keys are scoped per caller and tenant (never replayed across tenants), and an anonymous caller never gets a stored body replayed (status only). | `sandloom/core/tests/test_api_robustness.py::test_idempotency_never_replays_across_tenants`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_api_robustness.py::test_idempotency_anonymous_retry_is_deduped_without_body_replay`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_durable_idempotency_guard.py::test_key_is_scoped_to_caller_and_tenant`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_durable_idempotency_guard.py::test_anonymous_caller_gets_status_only` |

| <span class="sl-id">G-IDEM-17</span> | The automatic guard (user writes carrying Idempotency-Key, with no explicit guard, no_idempotency or operation intent) always replays the status only, for a DbSession write and for an ordinary write through db() (the lazy request unit holds the durable record) (mode S: Idempotent-Replay: true, empty body, the handler never runs again), including after an ownership transfer; replay_safe(reason=) opts a non-sensitive route in to body replay (mode B); a sensitive write is always S; the replay is decided after every route-level dependency (session check, gates, step-up); a different request under the same key is 422, and cross-route or cross-tenant reuse never replays. | `tests/integration/test_automatic_idempotency.py::test_the_automatic_guard_replays_the_status_only_never_a_body`<br>`tests/integration/test_automatic_idempotency.py::test_replay_safe_replays_the_body_after_every_route_dependency`<br>`tests/integration/test_automatic_idempotency.py::test_a_revoked_session_is_refused_before_any_replay`<br>`tests/integration/test_automatic_idempotency.py::test_mode_x_re_runs_authorization_and_the_handler`<br>`tests/integration/test_automatic_idempotency.py::test_a_lazy_db_write_gets_the_durable_status_replay` |

| <span class="sl-id">G-AUTH-11</span> | A claims contributor (core.add_claims_contributor) runs in its module's own UoW and is auto-exposed as <module>.claims.v1; a failing critical contributor, local or remote, aborts minting with ClaimsUnavailable (503), the first critical failure in registration order winning. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_runtime.py::test_local_contributor_runs_in_its_own_uow_and_is_exposed`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_runtime.py::test_critical_local_contributor_failure_is_503`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_runtime.py::test_critical_remote_contributor_failure_is_503`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_runtime.py::test_first_critical_failure_in_registration_order_wins` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-AUTH-12</span> | Every minted token carries claims_sources / claims_sources_failed; a module's claim is trusted only when that module is in claims_sources and not in claims_sources_failed, otherwise the fact is unknown and escalates to a live check. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_ops_security_hardening.py::test_claims_provenance_always_stamped`<br>`tests/integration/test_claims_provenance_and_subscribed.py::test_authoritative_provenance_trusts_only_listed_owner`<br>`tests/integration/test_claims_provenance_and_subscribed.py::test_owner_in_both_lists_is_not_trusted`<br>`tests/integration/test_claims_provenance_and_subscribed.py::test_subscribed_escalates_to_live_when_billing_failed_at_mint` |

### G-REVOKE

| Id | Statement | Enforced by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <span class="sl-id">G-REVOKE-01</span> | An access token is revoked iff its issue instant iat_us (microseconds) is <= its subject's revocation mark; a token without iat_us is revoked by any mark; every framework guard rejects a revoked token with 401 'Token has been revoked'. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_revocation_windows.py::test_token_issued_earlier_in_the_same_second_is_revoked`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_revocation_windows.py::test_a_token_without_iat_us_is_revoked_by_any_mark`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_auth_rotation_revocation.py::test_revoked_token_is_rejected_by_every_framework_guard` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-REVOKE-02</span> | The mark is written at now + AUTH_REVOCATION_CLOCK_SKEW_SECONDS, so a token from an issuer whose clock runs ahead is still revoked, while an issuer that ran the issuance check (ensure_user_not_blocked) and tokens minted later in the revoking request are stamped past it. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_revocation_windows.py::test_skew_margin_rejects_tokens_from_an_issuer_clock_running_ahead`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_revocation_windows.py::test_issuer_that_saw_the_mark_mints_past_the_margin`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_revocation_windows.py::test_tokens_minted_later_in_the_revoking_request_stay_valid` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-REVOKE-03</span> | The revocation mark is written with the cache's atomic set_max and never moves backwards; concurrent revocations of one subject all succeed and end at the maximum; a security cache with neither set_max nor cas is refused for revocation writes. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_auth_rotation_revocation.py::test_revocation_mark_never_moves_backwards`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_cache_set_max.py::test_concurrent_revocations_all_succeed_and_keep_the_max`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_cache_set_max.py::test_revocation_refuses_a_cache_without_set_max_or_cas`<br>`tests/integration/test_revocation_pipeline.py::test_b_concurrent_revocations_on_real_redis_keep_the_highest_mark` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-REVOKE-04</span> | revoke_user_tokens_on_commit writes the mark only after the UoW commits: a rolled-back change never revokes (logs out) the user. | `sandloom_tenancy/tests/test_security_hardening.py::test_rolled_back_member_removal_skips_the_post_commit_revocation`<br>`sandloom_tenancy/tests/test_security_hardening.py::test_rolled_back_org_deletion_skips_the_post_commit_revocation` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-REVOKE-05</span> | require_immediate=True writes the mark before COMMIT and, if that write fails, refuses the change with 503 (RevocationUnavailableError) and rolls it back; after commit a second mark max(mark, commit time + skew) revokes tokens minted between the early mark and the commit, and a commit slower than the skew also revokes the request's own tokens (counted auth_revocation_remark_overtook_floor_total). | `sandloom/core/tests/test_revocation_immediate_and_corrupt.py::test_immediate_revocation_writes_the_mark_before_commit`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_revocation_immediate_and_corrupt.py::test_immediate_revocation_refuses_the_change_on_a_cache_outage`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_revocation_immediate_and_corrupt.py::test_immediate_post_commit_remark_revokes_tokens_minted_before_commit`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_revocation_immediate_and_corrupt.py::test_a_commit_slower_than_the_skew_revokes_the_requests_own_tokens_loudly`<br>`tests/integration/test_revocation_pipeline.py::test_window_immediate_path_is_zero_or_the_change_is_refused` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-REVOKE-06</span> | Every bundled security event revokes the subject's tokens with require_immediate=True: tenancy member removal/leave, role change, ownership transfer (both parties), org deletion; identity role revocation, password change/reset, deactivation; block_user. | `sandloom_tenancy/tests/test_role_change_revocation.py::test_role_change_revokes_the_members_tokens`<br>`sandloom_tenancy/tests/test_role_change_revocation.py::test_ownership_transfer_revokes_both_parties`<br>`sandloom_tenancy/tests/test_security_hardening.py::test_member_removal_and_leave_revoke_the_users_tokens`<br>`sandloom_tenancy/tests/test_security_hardening.py::test_org_deletion_revokes_every_members_tokens`<br>`sandloom_identity/tests/api/test_security_api.py::test_role_revocation_is_immediate_on_identity_endpoints`<br>`tests/integration/test_revocation_pipeline.py::test_a_immediate_removal_needs_no_applier_after_a_crash`<br>**gap (S)**: No test pins that password change/reset and user deactivation use the immediate (pre-commit) path specifically, rather than only that tokens end up revoked. |
| <span class="sl-id">G-REVOKE-07</span> | Revocation is at-least-once: core.auth.tokens_revoked.v1 is written to the outbox in the same UoW, the post-commit mark write is retried AUTH_REVOCATION_WRITE_ATTEMPTS times, a still-failing write is counted (auth_revocation_deferred_total) and identity's durable consumer sessions@tokens_revoked applies it idempotently without ever lowering a newer mark. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_revocation_windows.py::test_revocation_is_persisted_in_the_uow_for_the_durable_applier`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_revocation_windows.py::test_exhausted_retries_count_a_deferred_revocation`<br>`sandloom_identity/tests/test_revocation_applier.py::test_applier_never_moves_a_newer_mark_backwards`<br>`tests/integration/test_revocation_pipeline.py::test_a_crash_after_a_failed_mark_write_is_applied_from_the_outbox` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-REVOKE-08</span> | The revocation applier is registered dead_letter=False: an outage is retried forever with capped backoff (never parked in the DLQ), only a malformed payload is dead-lettered at once, and while a revocation is stuck /ready answers 503 degraded with /health unaffected. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_revocation_never_dead_lettered.py::test_streams_outage_longer_than_the_old_budget_is_applied_not_dlqd`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_revocation_never_dead_lettered.py::test_streams_malformed_revocation_is_dead_lettered_at_once`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_revocation_never_dead_lettered.py::test_ready_degrades_while_a_revocation_is_stuck_liveness_unaffected`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_revocation_never_dead_lettered.py::test_redis_streams_never_dead_letter_group_survives_the_old_budget` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-REVOKE-09</span> | The mark lives AUTH_REVOCATION_MARK_TTL_SECONDS (default max(access TTL + 120 s, 24 h), never shorter than the access lifetime); a token older than the verifier's mark TTL is rejected (fail closed on lifetime drift) and /ready fails on ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES drift between services. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_auth_rotation_revocation.py::test_revocation_mark_outlives_other_services_tokens_by_default`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_auth_rotation_revocation.py::test_revocation_mark_ttl_setting_is_honoured_but_never_too_short`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_revocation_immediate_and_corrupt.py::test_a_token_older_than_the_mark_ttl_is_rejected_when_no_mark_exists`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_compat.py::test_ready_fails_on_access_token_lifetime_drift` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-REVOKE-10</span> | A subject-state record (sandloom:auth:subject:{id}) that exists but is not a valid value rejects every token of the subject on every authenticated route (one live GET, counted); the issuance check repairs it to now + skew, never deleting or lowering a readable record, and a revocation overwrites a corrupt record. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_revocation_immediate_and_corrupt.py::test_corrupt_mark_rejects_every_token_and_is_counted`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_revocation_immediate_and_corrupt.py::test_corrupt_mark_rejects_on_budgeted_reads_too`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_revocation_immediate_and_corrupt.py::test_issuance_check_repairs_a_corrupt_mark_so_relogin_works`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_revocation_immediate_and_corrupt.py::test_a_revocation_overwrites_a_corrupt_mark`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_subject_record.py::test_a_corrupt_record_fails_closed_and_issuance_repairs_it` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-REVOKE-11</span> | On a revocation-store outage AUTH_REVOCATION_FAIL_CLOSED decides (unset = closed in prod, open elsewhere): closed answers 503 on every authenticated route (the block cannot be confirmed, no copy answers); open accepts with a warning. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_auth_rotation_revocation.py::test_revocation_fail_closed_defaults_by_environment`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_revocation_freshness.py::test_redis_down_fail_closed`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_revocation_freshness.py::test_redis_down_fail_open_outside_prod`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_revocation_freshness.py::test_copy_expiring_during_block_read_fails_closed_on_outage` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-REVOKE-12</span> | Revocation is strict on every authenticated route: each request reads the subject-state record live with one GET, so a revocation applies on the very next request in every process; several guards on one request share the one lookup. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_revocation_freshness.py::test_strict_default_sees_revocation_on_next_request`<br>`tests/integration/test_revocation_pipeline.py::test_c_in_flight_request_completes_and_the_next_one_is_rejected`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_auth_rotation_revocation.py::test_revocation_lookup_runs_once_per_request`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_subject_record.py::test_the_hot_path_reads_one_key` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-REVOKE-17</span> | before_commit(callback) runs after the handler right before COMMIT and a raising check rolls the unit back; the commit-time re-check (subject_commit_check) runs before the COMMIT of every committing unit of the request, automatically on writes and writing GETs and under at_commit() for explicit commit obligations (replacing revocation_at_commit()); it re-reads the caller's subject-state record live there, so a revocation or block written during the request answers 401 with nothing committed (also for named-database units). | `sandloom/core/tests/test_before_commit.py::test_a_failing_check_rolls_back_instead_of_committing`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_before_commit.py::test_subject_check_sees_a_block_written_during_the_request`<br>`sandloom_tenancy/tests/test_accept_authority_at_commit.py::test_block_while_accepting_rolls_the_acceptance_back`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_kernel_review_regressions.py::test_revocation_at_commit_covers_named_db_in_either_dependency_order`<br>`tests/integration/test_route_runtime.py::test_a_block_during_a_write_that_declares_nothing_refuses_and_rolls_back`<br>`tests/integration/test_route_runtime.py::test_a_get_that_writes_is_rechecked_and_a_reading_get_is_not`<br>`tests/integration/test_route_runtime.py::test_a_foreign_revocation_between_two_commits_refuses_the_second` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-REVOKE-18</span> | While the commit-time re-check is armed, internal RPC sends described read methods unchanged and propagates remote commands (and methods of unknown kind) with the re-check in the MAC-covered context (rc: sub, iat_us; the provider re-checks in its own unit before COMMIT) instead of refusing them, so no remote command commits unchecked; every HTTP request (incl. nested ASGI and internal RPC) starts a fresh authority context and restores the caller's on return. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_security_review_regressions.py::test_guarded_request_never_sends_remote_command`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_security_review_regressions.py::test_guarded_request_can_still_send_described_remote_read`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_security_review_regressions.py::test_rpc_http_boundary_isolates_and_restores_outer_commit_authority`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_security_review_regressions.py::test_new_http_request_does_not_inherit_outer_issue_floors` |

| Id | Statement | Enforced by |

| <span class="sl-id">G-SENS-03</span> | Security risk: identity's credential services (password change, 2FA init / enable / disable / backup-code regeneration, SSO link / unlink) are @sensitive_effect("security", step_up=300); mark_reauthenticated() after the current-password check (or a recent auth_time) satisfies it, so identity's behaviour is unchanged. The step-up is enforced identically when the effect runs in a contract command served over RPC: the signed caller facts carry the end user's auth_time and the request's re-authentication to the provider, whose call runs in a request scope built from them (with or without a commit-time re-check context, on an operation-intent route too), so stale auth is 401 and fresh auth or a re-authentication passes, local and remote alike; a re-authentication or a pending step-up the remote execution leaves comes back with its response. | `tests/integration/test_sensitive_risk.py::test_a_security_effect_needs_a_recent_auth_time_or_a_reauthentication`<br>`tests/integration/test_rpc_caller_parity.py::test_step_up_is_enforced_alike_local_and_split`<br>`tests/integration/test_rpc_caller_parity.py::test_a_reauthentication_in_a_remote_command_reaches_the_request`<br>`tests/integration/test_rpc_caller_parity.py::test_a_split_call_matches_the_local_one` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-SENS-04</span> | Every sensitive write gets exactly one automatic, mandatory audit row (sandloom.sensitive_write) in the request's writing unit: actor, route template, method, path parameters, risks with their sources and the route's status; never the body; no row for a read or a refused request; a money command marks the caller's request alike locally and remotely (from the describe document before the call, and from the MAC-bound risks of the response: every risk the remote execution observed, its nested calls' included, so an untagged command calling a money command marks the request as it would locally; the risks travel on error responses too, merged before the caller raises, so a wrapper that raises after its nested money command committed still marks the request; a command REPLAY, local or remote (the proxy's automatic retry after a lost answer included), marks the caller exactly like its first execution: the durable command record (and the cache fallback) keeps the risks the execution observed and the replay re-applies them, its on_commit callbacks' included (round 5: the cache record is written after the callbacks ran; the durable record commits with the body's effects plus what each queued callback declares - a @sensitive_effect callback's risk and step-up, fail closed - and is corrected with what the callbacks actually left once they ran, a closure's included; a process death between the commit and that correction replays the declared callbacks' risks and nothing of a closure; round 6: the correction - and the cache record - is written on EVERY exit after the commit, a cancelled callback (a request timeout) included, with what the callbacks left until then plus what the queued ones declare when they did not all finish (fail closed), in a task shielded from the caller's cancellation (anyio cancels again at every await), bounded (5 s) and never raising into the caller: a closure that completed a money effect before its request was cancelled is on the record, so a later replay owes the audit too)), so the audit does not change after a split or a retry; such a command commits in its own unit, as does a risky effect run inside any contract unit (locally too), so the request writes its row even when its own units wrote nothing (the route runtime opens the request unit when the handler opened none). | |
| <span class="sl-id">G-SENS-05</span> | Money dedupe is mandatory: a money effect needs a dedupe record (its own operation_key, the request's request_operation_key(), a command key or a ledger key); a client without Idempotency-Key gets 428 (SANDLOOM-R010); a route that cannot dedupe the key it got is SANDLOOM-R009 (a route whose only money effect is a command is held to the same rules: the command key is its dedupe record); a sensitive("money") write committing without either is refused before COMMIT; at startup a money route whose idempotency guard is the response-storing cache form or fail-open is refused (SANDLOOM-B019), while durable=True or store_response=False + fail_closed=True guards are accepted. | `tests/integration/test_sensitive_risk.py::test_injected_session_keeps_risk_bound_through_dependency_commit`<br>`tests/integration/test_sensitive_risk.py::test_a_money_effect_needs_a_dedupe_record_or_answers_428`<br>`tests/integration/test_sensitive_risk.py::test_a_key_the_route_cannot_dedupe_is_a_developer_error`<br>`tests/integration/test_sensitive_risk.py::test_a_money_route_commits_only_with_a_deduped_money_effect_or_a_key`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_durable_idempotency_guard.py::test_f_route_refuses_a_replay_only_guard`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_durable_idempotency_guard.py::test_f_route_accepts_durable_and_endpoint_owned_guards`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_durable_idempotency_guard.py::test_bundled_f_routes_pass_and_the_platform_wraps_no_route`<br>`tests/integration/test_sensitive_risk.py::test_a_command_only_money_route_gets_its_audit_row` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-SENS-06</span> | Step-up (RFC 9470): an effect declaring step_up=N (security: 300 s) needs auth_time (never iat) at most N s old or mark_reauthenticated() in the request, else 401 WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="insufficient_user_authentication", max_age=N (SANDLOOM-R011); checked at entry, at the effect's return and before the writing unit's COMMIT; a sensitive("security") route refuses before the response, reads included. | `tests/integration/test_sensitive_risk.py::test_a_security_effect_needs_a_recent_auth_time_or_a_reauthentication`<br>`tests/integration/test_sensitive_risk.py::test_a_security_route_refuses_before_the_response_even_on_a_read` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-SENS-07</span> | Risk is a join: Requirement.risks() is the union over And / Or and empty under Not; a route's resolved risk is the union of its sources (admin gates, @sensitive_effect dependencies, sensitive() markers) whatever their order or repetition, each naming its sources; the derived step-up is the strictest of its contributors' (obligations are a homomorphism). | `tests/laws/test_risk_join_laws.py::test_requirement_risks_are_a_union`<br>`tests/laws/test_risk_join_laws.py::test_route_risk_is_the_join_of_its_sources`<br>`tests/laws/test_risk_join_laws.py::test_obligations_are_a_homomorphism` |

| <span class="sl-id">G-AUTHZ-01</span> | Authorization decisions are three-valued (allow / deny / indeterminate) and keep their status: a definite Subscribed/Credits denial (of= an explicit Account) is 402, an unregistered or unavailable fact or a missing contract is 501, an unreachable owner is 503; an indeterminate branch never yields allow through Or/Not. | `tests/integration/test_shared_authz_review.py::test_http_subscribed_denial_is_402`<br>`tests/integration/test_shared_authz_review.py::test_http_unregistered_fact_is_501_not_403`<br>`tests/integration/test_shared_authz_review.py::test_or_with_erroring_branch_does_not_allow`<br>`tests/integration/test_shared_authz_review.py::test_double_negation_of_error_still_denies`<br>`tests/integration/test_access_facts_split.py::test_unreachable_owner_is_503` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-AUTHZ-02</span> | require(...) evaluates the cheapest tier first (claims -> resource -> live) and short-circuits; a claims-only policy such as require(Subscribed(of=Account.user())) opens no DB session and does no I/O. | `tests/integration/test_shared_authz_review.py::test_http_claims_only_policy_opens_no_db_session`<br>`tests/integration/test_authz_algebra.py::test_cheap_claim_short_circuits_before_resource_load`<br>`tests/integration/test_access_subsystem.py::test_and_returns_first_failing_cheapest_first` |

(of= required) are live and authoritative, resolved through the owner's contract (local, or the SERVICE_BINDINGS RPC proxy when remote). | `tests/integration/test_shared_authz_review.py::test_credits_uses_remote_binding_proxy`<br>`tests/integration/test_shared_authz_review.py::test_subscription_active_uses_remote_binding_proxy`<br>`tests/integration/test_shared_authz_review.py::test_http_credits_denial_is_402_with_reason_detail` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-AUTHZ-04</span> | Registering an access fact auto-exposes <owner>.facts.v1; a process without the owner that binds it in SERVICE_BINDINGS gets the same decision as the monolith, with the declarative ClaimRule travelling over RPC (describe, cached). | `tests/integration/test_access_facts_split.py::test_entitled_subscription_same_decision_in_split`<br>`tests/integration/test_access_facts_split.py::test_owner_settings_drive_the_remote_claim_rule`<br>`tests/integration/test_access_facts_split.py::test_describe_is_declarative_and_cached`<br>`tests/integration/test_access_facts_split.py::test_unbound_fact_is_501_not_500` |

### G-BILLING

| Id | Statement | Enforced by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <span class="sl-id">G-BILLING-01</span> | Checkout and customer-portal run as operation_intent routes, authorize on get_member_state (role + membership version) and commit a pending operation intent BEFORE any PSP call, keying the PSP call with the intent id (sandloom:intent:<id>): an owner outage at authorize creates nothing (503), a PSP timeout leaves the intent pending (503) and a retry reuses the same PSP session, a definitive PSP 4xx fails the intent (502). | `sandloom_billing/tests/test_operation_intents.py::test_checkout_persists_an_issued_intent_keyed_to_the_psp_session`<br>`sandloom_billing/tests/test_operation_intents.py::test_org_checkout_records_the_authorized_membership_version`<br>`sandloom_billing/tests/test_operation_intents.py::test_psp_timeout_then_retry_reuses_the_intent_and_the_psp_session`<br>`sandloom_billing/tests/test_operation_intents.py::test_a_definitive_psp_rejection_fails_the_intent`<br>`sandloom_billing/tests/test_operation_intents.py::test_owner_unreachable_at_authorize_creates_nothing` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-BILLING-02</span> | Right before the issue commit the final re-read, wrapped in release_check, checks the membership state (role lost 403, other change 409, owner unreachable fail closed) and the caller's subject-state record (401); any refusal revokes the pending intent (audited), expires the checkout session and never returns the URL (a portal URL is never handed out). | `sandloom_billing/tests/test_operation_intents.py::test_role_loss_during_checkout_revokes_the_intent_and_expires_the_session`<br>`sandloom_billing/tests/test_operation_intents.py::test_role_loss_during_portal_revokes_the_intent_and_withholds_the_url`<br>`sandloom_billing/tests/test_operation_intents.py::test_block_during_personal_checkout_revokes_and_expires`<br>`sandloom_billing/tests/test_f_class_authority.py::test_other_membership_change_during_the_psp_call_is_409`<br>`sandloom_billing/tests/test_operation_intents.py::test_owner_unreachable_at_the_recheck_revokes_and_expires` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-BILLING-03</span> | The F-route authorization is serializable, not linearizable: a tenancy change committed before the final re-read is refused, one committed between the final re-read and the issue COMMIT is not seen (the acknowledged, pinned residual window). | `sandloom_billing/tests/test_operation_intents.py::test_role_change_committed_before_the_final_reread_is_refused`<br>`sandloom_billing/tests/test_operation_intents.py::test_window_role_change_after_the_final_reread_is_not_seen` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-BILLING-04</span> | Intent lifecycle: every transition (issue, revoke, fail, reconciler) is guarded by WHERE status='pending'; issued, revoked and failed are terminal — no retry, refusal, PSP error or reconciler run changes an issued intent or replaces its session. | `sandloom_billing/tests/test_operation_intents.py::test_closing_an_issued_intent_is_a_no_op`<br>`sandloom_billing/tests/test_operation_intents.py::test_issuing_an_issued_intent_again_is_refused`<br>`sandloom_billing/tests/test_operation_intents.py::test_failed_recheck_on_retry_never_revokes_an_issued_intent`<br>`sandloom_billing/tests/test_intent_reconcile.py::test_reconciler_never_touches_an_issued_intent` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-BILLING-05</span> | Operation-intent route retries never hand out a bearer URL without fresh authorization: the guard stores no response (store_response=False); an issued checkout retry re-runs the re-read (release_check) and returns the stored URL without a PSP call (403 and no URL after authority loss, 410 past the session expiry); an issued portal retry is 409. | `sandloom_billing/tests/test_operation_intents.py::test_retry_of_an_issued_intent_returns_its_url_without_a_psp_call`<br>`sandloom_billing/tests/test_operation_intents.py::test_demoted_manager_retrying_an_issued_checkout_gets_no_url`<br>`sandloom_billing/tests/test_operation_intents.py::test_retry_of_an_issued_portal_intent_is_refused_without_a_psp_call`<br>`sandloom_billing/tests/test_operation_intents.py::test_demoted_manager_cannot_replay_a_portal_url_with_a_new_token`<br>`sandloom_billing/tests/test_intent_reconcile.py::test_retry_of_an_issued_checkout_after_its_session_expired_is_410` |

### G-CONTRACT

| Id | Statement | Enforced by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <span class="sl-id">G-CONTRACT-01</span> | Every contract call, local or served over RPC, runs in the PROVIDER's own Unit of Work on the provider module's database (never the caller's session, which is restored afterwards); a read contract's transaction is always rolled back and a command contract commits its own UoW. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_runtime.py::test_local_call_runs_in_providers_own_uow_on_its_own_database`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_runtime.py::test_command_commits_and_requires_idempotency_key`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_service_rpc.py::test_rpc_server_runs_contract_in_provider_uow`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_runtime.py::test_local_and_rpc_paths_are_identical` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-CONTRACT-02</span> | A read contract that publishes an event, writes an audit/outbox row, queues an on_commit effect, adds/modifies ORM objects or runs raw DML raises ReadContractWriteError (in its own UoW and inside a shared read scope) and its writes never persist. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_runtime.py::test_read_contract_cannot_publish`<br>`tests/integration/test_read_contract_writes.py::test_read_contract_write_fails_loudly`<br>`tests/integration/test_read_contract_writes.py::test_pure_read_still_succeeds` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-CONTRACT-03</span> | A command contract must name a mandatory idempotency-key argument at registration, and a call with an empty key is refused (ContractIdempotencyKeyMissing) before any UoW opens. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_runtime.py::test_command_contract_must_name_its_idempotency_key`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_runtime.py::test_command_commits_and_requires_idempotency_key` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-CONTRACT-04</span> | Contract signatures take no session: a provider method with a session parameter is refused at registration (and by the architecture test), and a session passed by a caller, positionally or by keyword, is 422 ContractArgumentError before any UoW opens, locally and over RPC. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_runtime.py::test_caller_session_is_an_argument_error`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_service_rpc.py::test_a_session_taking_provider_is_refused_at_registration`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_service_rpc.py::test_remote_proxy_decodes_uuid_and_refuses_a_session_argument`<br>`tests/architecture/test_contract_methods_no_session.py::test_registered_contracts_take_no_session` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-CONTRACT-05</span> | register_service raises ContractTypeError for a provider with a public member that is not a @contract_method, an unannotated or non-wire-type parameter/return, or *args/**kwargs; a local provider exposes only its contract methods (private members and unknown names raise AttributeError). | `sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_parity.py::test_non_portable_contracts_are_rejected_at_registration`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_parity.py::test_local_provider_exposes_only_contract_methods`<br>`tests/laws/test_wire_codec_laws.py::test_a_non_wire_annotation_is_refused_wherever_it_sits` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-CONTRACT-06</span> | Arguments bind with Python's rules identically on the local and RPC paths: unknown/typo kwargs, missing arguments, positional-only by keyword, keyword-only positionally and arguments failing annotation validation are 422 ContractArgumentError both ways. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_parity.py::test_local_and_rpc_results_and_errors_are_identical`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_parity.py::test_rpc_type_fidelity`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_runtime.py::test_runtime_command_binds_its_arguments_once_per_layer` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-CONTRACT-07</span> | Results are encoded once and decoded against the return annotation on both paths, so a local caller receives exactly the types a remote one does (a pydantic model not a dict, an Enum not its value, exact Decimal, UUID, tuple/set/frozenset, non-string map keys), with a stable digest independent of the hash seed; a Contract(REF) caller receives each DTO as the class its generated stub names (the generated copy, G-CONTRACT-19) on both paths, every field set as read off the wire. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_parity.py::test_rpc_type_fidelity`<br>`tests/sdk/test_sdk_contract_dtos.py::test_a_caller_receives_the_copy_equal_to_the_providers_value`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_parity.py::test_wire_codec_round_trips_exactly`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_parity.py::test_set_digest_is_stable_across_hash_seeds`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_codec_v2.py::test_local_plan_equals_v1_roundtrip` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-CONTRACT-08</span> | SANDLOOM-C012. A business module registering a contract whose pydantic model / Enum (nested included) is a class of ANOTHER module's package, or one defined in a function or __main__, fails with ContractTypeError naming the DTO, the method position and the fix; a DTO of the provider's own package (the norm: its schemas module) or of a shared package (sandloom.shared.*, CONTRACT_DTO_PACKAGES) is accepted, and sandloom generate writes a copy of each own DTO into the shared DTO package. `sandloom check` (contract-dtos) reports an own-package DTO a contract signature (an @contract class's public method or a @contract_method) names that has no generated copy. A remote caller that has not imported a DTO's class decodes it into a loaded generated copy of it, else as plain data, and never imports a module named by the peer. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_dto_locality.py::test_module_contract_with_own_package_dto_is_accepted`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_dto_locality.py::test_a_function_local_dto_is_refused`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_dto_locality.py::test_nested_enum_of_another_loaded_module_is_refused`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_dto_locality.py::test_remote_decode_degrades_when_the_dto_is_not_importable`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_dto_locality.py::test_remote_decode_resolves_a_loaded_generated_copy`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_dto_locality.py::test_shared_and_declared_dto_packages_are_accepted`<br>`tests/architecture/test_archcheck_library.py::test_contract_dto_leaks_detected`<br>rule `contract-dtos` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-CONTRACT-09</span> | A provider HTTPException or http_status-protocol exception reaches the caller as ContractCallError with the same status, detail, headers (e.g. Retry-After) and code locally AND over RPC; a domain 401/403 stays 401/403 over RPC, never a 503. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_parity.py::test_domain_403_over_rpc_is_not_a_503`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_parity.py::test_retry_after_header_survives_rpc`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_parity.py::test_local_and_rpc_results_and_errors_are_identical`<br>`sandloom_billing/tests/test_contract_conformance.py::test_foreign_org_spend_is_403_not_503_over_rpc` |

| <span class="sl-id">G-CONTRACT-11</span> | An AttributeError / ValueError (or any unexpected exception) escaping provider code is a provider failure — 500 locally, 503 RemoteServiceUnavailable code=provider_error remotely — and is never masked as the endpoint's 404 method_not_found or 422 binding error. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_service_rpc.py::test_rpc_errors_inside_provider_are_not_masked_as_404_or_422`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_parity.py::test_local_and_rpc_results_and_errors_are_identical` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-CONTRACT-12</span> | At startup every ContractRequirement in ModuleDescriptor.consumes must be provided locally or bound in SERVICE_BINDINGS: a missing required one raises ContractBindingError (startup aborts), a missing optional one only warns, and the shipped modules declare what they consume. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_consumes_preflight.py::test_missing_required_consumed_contract_aborts_startup`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_consumes_preflight.py::test_missing_optional_consumed_contract_only_warns`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_consumes_preflight.py::test_provider_loaded_later_or_binding_satisfies`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_module_boots_alone.py::test_required_missing_contract_is_the_explicit_refusal` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-CONTRACT-13</span> | Inside a request read scope LOCAL read-contract calls on one database share one contract-pool connection (READ COMMITTED, always rolled back) that never sees the caller's uncommitted writes; a failing call discards the shared transaction and nested/concurrent calls fall back to their own UoW. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_read_scope.py::test_calls_in_a_scope_share_one_connection`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_read_scope.py::test_scope_never_sees_the_callers_uncommitted_writes`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_read_scope.py::test_failed_call_discards_the_shared_transaction`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_read_scope.py::test_nested_and_concurrent_calls_fall_back_to_their_own_uow` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-CONTRACT-14</span> | Identical local and RPC read calls (contract, method, bound tenant, arguments) are memoised for the request, each hit is an independent copy, the memo is keyed by the bound tenant, any command call (local or remote) clears it, and the HTTP boundary never inherits another request's memo. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_read_scope.py::test_memo_serves_repeats_and_a_command_invalidates_it`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_parity.py::test_external_changes_and_command_invalidation_have_same_read_policy`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_read_scope.py::test_memo_hits_are_independent_copies`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_read_scope.py::test_memo_is_keyed_by_bound_tenant` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-CONTRACT-15</span> | In-process contract UoWs use a dedicated per-database pool (CONTRACT_DB_POOL_SIZE) so a nested contract call succeeds even with DB_POOL_SIZE=1, and contract connections carry lock_timeout (CONTRACT_DB_LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS) so a contract waiting on its caller's row lock fails fast instead of deadlocking. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_pool.py::test_nested_contract_call_with_request_pool_size_one_succeeds`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_pool.py::test_without_the_contract_pool_the_nested_call_starves`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_pool.py::test_contract_waiting_on_callers_row_lock_fails_fast` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-CONTRACT-16</span> | The typed wire codec v2 is used only for fully typed annotations and only once the provider is described and its contract hash matches the caller's accepted hash; any value not exactly fitting falls back to codec 1 with unchanged coercion/errors, and on the local path only immutable exact-type values skip the round trip (mutables are copied); codec 1 round-trips every wire value, local equals remote and codec 1 equals codec 2 when fully typed (properties), and an int beyond 64 bits crosses RPC tagged (bigint) so local still equals remote. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_codec_v2.py::test_server_answers_typed_only_for_the_accepted_contract_hash`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_codec_v2.py::test_new_client_new_server_uses_typed_codec`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_codec_v2.py::test_local_plan_rejects_like_v1`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_codec_v2.py::test_immutable_exact_values_pass_through_and_mutables_are_copied`<br>`tests/laws/test_wire_codec_laws.py::test_codec_1_round_trips_every_wire_value`<br>`tests/laws/test_wire_codec_laws.py::test_local_equals_remote`<br>`tests/laws/test_wire_codec_laws.py::test_codec_1_equals_codec_2_when_fully_typed`<br>`tests/laws/test_wire_codec_laws.py::test_an_int_beyond_64_bits_does_not_cross_rpc` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-CONTRACT-17</span> | Every shipped contract (tenancy.membership.v1, billing.entitlements.v1, billing.credits.v1, billing.facts.v1, *.claims.v1) gives identical results and errors locally and over RPC under assert_contract_conformance. | `sandloom_tenancy/tests/test_contract_conformance.py::test_tenancy_contracts_conform`<br>`sandloom_billing/tests/test_contract_conformance.py::test_billing_contracts_conform`<br>`sandloom_billing/tests/test_facts_contract_conformance.py::test_billing_facts_contract_conforms`<br>`sandloom_identity/tests/test_contract_conformance.py::test_identity_claims_contract_conforms` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-CONTRACT-18</span> | Read contracts keep no idempotency record on either path, and the RPC layer adds no dedupe record of its own (commands share the contract runtime's single record). | `sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_parity.py::test_reads_persist_no_idempotency_record`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_parity.py::test_command_dedupe_is_shared_bounded_and_size_capped`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_service_rpc.py::test_command_contract_is_deduped_by_the_framework_locally_and_over_rpc` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-CONTRACT-19</span> | Contract DTOs are authored in the provider and copied for callers: sandloom generate writes a wire-shape copy of every DTO a provided contract signature names (nested ones included) into <shared>/contracts/<module>_dto.py, each class marked @dto_copy with its origin, and the stub names the copy and passes its Protocol (ContractRef(name, Protocol)). A Contract(REF) caller - and Contract(REF, optional=True).client() - receives results as the stub annotates them (the copy's class), on the local path and over RPC (with or without the provider's package imported in the caller process), equal to what the provider returned; a frozen copy of immutable scalars is rebuilt without revalidation, anything else through one JSON round trip; a result already of the stub's class, or naming no model / Enum, is not converted. The provider receives its own class for a copy the caller passes, on both paths. | `tests/sdk/test_sdk_contract_dtos.py::test_a_caller_receives_the_copy_equal_to_the_providers_value`<br>`tests/sdk/test_sdk_contract_dtos.py::test_the_fast_path_copies_a_frozen_scalar_dto_without_revalidating`<br>`tests/sdk/test_sdk_contract_dtos.py::test_the_stub_names_the_copies_and_passes_its_protocol`<br>`tests/sdk/test_sdk_contract_dtos.py::test_every_copied_class_is_marked_and_carries_the_wire_shape`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_dto_locality.py::test_remote_decode_resolves_a_loaded_generated_copy`<br>`sandloom_identity/tests/test_contact_contract.py::test_get_contact_and_get_contacts` |

### G-COMPAT

| Id | Statement | Enforced by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <span class="sl-id">G-COMPAT-01</span> | Each bundled module commits contracts.snapshot.json equal to the rendered describe documents of its registered contracts; a stale or missing snapshot fails the suite. For L1 modules, sandloom generate compares every generated file with the committed one before writing anything (SANDLOOM-T004 contracts, T005 events, T007 stubs, C012 DTO copies, T001 a route that lost its authentication); sandloom test, dev and --ci alike, only checks and fails on a stale file, listing it under "generated files are stale: run `sandloom generate`". | `sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_compat.py::test_committed_module_snapshots_match_registered_contracts`<br>`tests/sdk/test_sdk_generated.py::test_apply_writes_in_dev_and_fails_stale_in_ci`<br>`tests/sdk/test_sdk_generated.py::test_a_stale_file_asks_for_sandloom_generate_and_is_left_alone`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_run_tests_cli.py::test_sandloom_test_never_writes_a_generated_file`<br>`tests/sdk/test_sdk_generated.py::test_stub_compatibility_is_additive`<br>`tests/sdk/test_sdk_generated.py::test_a_route_that_loses_its_authentication_is_incompatible`<br>`tests/sdk/test_sdk_generated.py::test_a_generated_stub_is_ruff_formatted` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-COMPAT-02</span> | The compatibility comparison reports as breaking a removed method/parameter, a newly required parameter, a changed position/kind/idempotency key and a narrowed parameter or incompatible result type, and passes additive changes (new methods, optional parameters/fields, widened parameter types). | `sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_compat.py::test_additive_changes_are_compatible`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_compat.py::test_breaking_changes_are_reported_precisely`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_compat.py::test_type_and_order_changes_are_reported`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_compat.py::test_narrowing_a_parameter_type_is_breaking` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-COMPAT-03</span> | `sandloom contracts check --against <snapshot>` exits 0 on additive changes and 1 on breaking ones (default --as provider), and with --as consumer reports methods the released provider lacks. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_compat.py::test_cli_check_against_snapshot`<br>**gap (S)**: No test drives `sandloom contracts check --against http://<provider>` (live describe document over the internal token) or the `sandloom contracts snapshot --write/--check` CLI exit codes (only the underlying functions are tested). |
| <span class="sl-id">G-COMPAT-04</span> | With CONTRACT_COMPAT_CHECK=ready (default) a caller compares every reachable remote-bound provider's live describe document with the provider module's snapshot (found in its package without importing it): an incompatible provider fails /ready with contract_incompatible, an additive one passes. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_compat.py::test_ready_fails_on_an_incompatible_provider`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_compat.py::test_ready_passes_on_an_additive_provider`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_compat.py::test_expectation_is_found_in_the_provider_package_without_importing_it` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-COMPAT-05</span> | ContractRequirement(name, methods=(...)) narrows the compatibility check to the methods the consumer calls, so breaks in other methods do not fail /ready. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_compat.py::test_methods_the_consumer_does_not_call_do_not_fail_ready`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_compat.py::test_methods_narrow_the_check` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-COMPAT-06</span> | CONTRACT_COMPAT_CHECK=strict aborts startup on a reachable incompatible provider, ready only logs at startup (and fails /ready), and off restores reachability-only readiness. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_compat.py::test_startup_check_strict_raises_ready_only_logs`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_compat.py::test_compat_check_off_restores_reachability_only` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-COMPAT-07</span> | A provider describe document without model field information yields a warning (contracts_unverified), not an incompatibility failure. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_compat.py::test_model_without_field_info_is_a_warning_not_an_error`<br>**gap (S)**: The startup log for a remote binding with no snapshot at all ("unchecked", CONTRACT_SNAPSHOT_PATHS absent) is not asserted. |

### G-RPC

| Id | Statement | Enforced by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-01</span> | The request key K_req is HKDF-SHA256 over the X25519 agreement of caller and provider with a role-ordered, direction-labelled info naming both services and kids: both sides derive the same key, the reverse direction and swapped ids give different keys, and it is domain-separated from the response-binding key (committed test vectors pin the schedule). | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_both_sides_derive_the_same_directional_pair_key`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_request_key_is_domain_separated_from_the_response_binding_key`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_swapped_ids_and_wrong_direction_key_are_refused`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_committed_vectors` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-02</span> | Low-order / non-canonical X25519 points and an all-zero shared secret never yield a usable pair key: they are refused at startup for every configured pair and at verification for a published caller key. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_low_order_points_never_yield_a_predictable_key`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_all_zero_agreement_is_refused_even_if_the_library_returned_it`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_low_order_published_caller_key_is_refused_at_verification` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-03</span> | The MAC input is a fixed-arity length-prefixed (injective) encoding of caller, caller kid, provider, provider kid, HTTP method, target, nonce, raw context bytes and body SHA-256; tampering with any one field makes the request fail verification. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_encoding_is_injective_on_classic_ambiguities`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_encoding_round_trips_and_never_collides_fuzz`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_mac_input_fields_all_change_the_encoding`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_each_tampered_mac_field_is_refused` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-04</span> | The provider verifies the single canonical X-SANDLOOM-RPC-Auth header and full 32-byte tag over the raw bytes before decoding the context or body; malformed headers, non-canonical/truncated tags, a nonce that is not 128-bit lowercase hex, unknown kids and contexts with duplicate JSON keys are all 401 rpc_auth_invalid. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_malformed_headers_and_tags_are_refused`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_non_canonical_tag_encoding_is_refused`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_unknown_kids_are_refused`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_context_with_duplicate_keys_is_refused` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-05</span> | Requests are audience-bound by construction: a request MACed for provider P never verifies at another service Q (aud must equal RPC_SERVICE_ID, the key names P), and a compromised peer cannot forge another caller's request to a third service. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_wrong_audience_is_refused`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_captured_request_replayed_to_another_service_is_refused`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_a_peer_cannot_forge_another_callers_request`<br>`tests/split_conformance/test_split_conformance.py::test_internal_rpc_requires_an_allowed_pair_mac` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-06</span> | A request is fresh only when \|now - iat\| <= RPC_AUTH_MAX_SKEW_SECONDS (symmetric); otherwise 401 rpc_auth_expired, including out-of-range iat values (never a 500), and accepted requests skewed beyond half the window are counted per caller. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_freshness_window_is_symmetric_and_strict`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_r5_out_of_range_issue_times_are_expired_not_500`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_clock_skew_beyond_half_the_window_is_counted` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-07</span> | The per-process nonce replay guard, consulted only after the tag verified and the caller is authorized, refuses a repeated (caller, nonce) within the window with 401 rpc_auth_replayed, keeps entries until the request could no longer be fresh, never evicts a live nonce (fails closed 503 rpc_replay_unavailable when full, never rebuilt) and caps one caller's share of the table. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_captured_request_replayed_to_the_same_provider_is_refused`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_replay_guard_detects_expires_and_fails_closed_when_full`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_r3_an_unauthorized_peer_cannot_fill_the_replay_guard`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_one_caller_cannot_take_the_whole_nonce_table` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-08</span> | With RPC_REPLAY_GUARD=commands (default) command calls (all calls with `all`) are also claimed by an atomic SET NX on the security cache under a collision-free key with a constant 3*skew TTL, so a replay landing on another process/replica is refused; a cache outage fails closed in prod and open outside it. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_shared_nonce_layer_catches_a_replay_on_another_process`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_commands_mode_uses_the_shared_layer_for_commands_only`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_shared_nonce_layer_outage_fails_closed_in_prod_only`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_r7_shared_replay_keys_never_collide` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-09</span> | RPC_REPLAY_GUARD=local is refused in production, and outside production a startup warning says the shared nonce layer fails open. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_local_replay_guard_is_refused_in_prod`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_startup_warns_that_the_shared_guard_fails_open_outside_prod` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-10</span> | The provider binds the tenant only from the MAC-covered X-SANDLOOM-RPC-Context; a bare X-Tenant-Id header on an RPC request is 400 rpc_unsigned_tenant, and the proxy propagates the caller's bound tenant inside the MACed context. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_service_rpc.py::test_rpc_server_rebinds_tenant_only_from_verified_context`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_x_tenant_id_is_refused_on_the_mac_path`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_service_rpc.py::test_rpc_proxy_propagates_bound_tenant_in_the_mac_covered_context` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-11</span> | RPC_ALLOWED_CALLS is deny-by-default and consulted with the verified MAC caller id: a verified caller not allowed the contract/method gets 403 rpc_caller_forbidden at the provider; between real processes the ops token alone opens no contract and a caller is held to its own bindings. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_allowlist.py::test_unlisted_method_is_forbidden`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_allowlist.py::test_unlisted_caller_is_forbidden`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_allowlist.py::test_allowed_caller_succeeds`<br>`tests/split_conformance/test_split_conformance.py::test_internal_rpc_requires_an_allowed_pair_mac` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-12</span> | A caller whose own RPC_ALLOWED_CALLS entry does not cover every contract in its SERVICE_BINDINGS refuses to start, and the shipped microservices profile's allowlist equals the one derived from its bindings. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_allowlist.py::test_every_bound_contract_must_be_allowed_for_the_caller`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_deploy_profiles.py::test_rpc_allowlist_is_derived_from_bindings` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-13</span> | With RPC_COMMANDS_REQUIRE_SIGNATURE on, a command call (and every not-yet-described method) must also carry the MAC caller's own Ed25519 signature covering the context (incl. audience and the attempt's nonce), target and body, so a leaked provider X25519 key forges reads at most, never effects: forged, foreign-signed or re-MACed commands are refused with no effect, and `all` requires signatures on reads too. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_kci_a_leaked_provider_key_forges_reads_but_never_commands`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_kci_a_command_signed_by_another_service_is_refused`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_kci_a_captured_signed_command_cannot_be_re_maced_under_a_new_nonce`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_all_mode_signs_and_requires_reads_too` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-14</span> | RPC_COMMANDS_REQUIRE_SIGNATURE=auto is on in prod and off in dev/test; `off` and stale (unpublished) RPC_DH_EXTRA_PRIVATE_KEYS kids are refused under multi_tenant_strict (stale kids warned otherwise), and a calling service without RPC_PRIVATE_KEY refuses to start while the requirement is on. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_commands_require_signature_defaults_and_startup_rule`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_strict_profile_refuses_unsigned_commands_and_stale_extra_keys`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_allowlist.py::test_signed_commands_need_the_callers_ed25519_key` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-15</span> | Every SERVICE_BINDINGS entry must pin its provider with service_id (startup refuses otherwise), and a caller never sends a call it cannot MAC: an unpinned binding or a provider without a published X25519 key fails 503 rpc_auth_unavailable with nothing sent. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_allowlist.py::test_every_binding_must_pin_its_provider`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_caller_never_falls_back_without_a_pair_key`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_keyed_binding.py::test_an_unpinned_binding_never_sends_a_call`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_keyed_binding.py::test_every_binding_is_pinned_to_a_keyed_provider` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-16</span> | A process with SERVICE_BINDINGS refuses to start without its own RPC_DH_PRIVATE_KEY, a provider without one refuses every RPC call (unkeyed), and a monolith with no bindings needs no RPC keys. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_allowlist.py::test_caller_with_bindings_needs_its_own_x25519_key`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_keyed_binding.py::test_a_caller_refuses_to_start_without_its_x25519_key`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_keyed_binding.py::test_provider_without_an_x25519_key_refuses_unkeyed`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_allowlist.py::test_a_monolith_needs_no_rpc_keys` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-17</span> | Boot refuses unusable RPC key configurations: own X25519 key missing or not matching its published half, an Ed25519 private key not matching its published key, non-X25519 / non-Ed25519 keys in the maps, duplicate published X25519 keys, an underivable pair, and an X25519 key equal to the Ed25519 signing seed. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_startup_refuses_unusable_configurations`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_startup_refuses_a_dh_key_that_is_the_signing_seed`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_keyed_binding.py::test_x25519_key_configuration_is_validated`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_allowlist.py::test_private_key_must_be_the_published_one` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-18</span> | Every provider-side authentication/authorization rejection (rpc_auth_*, rpc_identity_*, rpc_context_*, rpc_caller_forbidden, rpc_replay_unavailable) and every unkeyed error answer surfaces at the caller as 503 RemoteServiceUnavailable carrying the provider's code, never as the provider's 401/403. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_auth_failures_are_503_at_the_caller_with_a_stable_code`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_allowlist.py::test_proxy_of_an_unlisted_caller_gets_503` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-19</span> | A caller accepts a response only when it echoes the attempt's nonce and carries a valid v2 pair-keyed MAC from the pinned service_id; stale, swapped, wrong-request-id, unsolicited, unbound, unkeyed, forged or other-service responses are rejected (never returned as a result, even under concurrency with random faults). | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_response_binding.py::test_peer_returning_a_stale_response_of_another_call`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_response_binding.py::test_an_unbound_reply_is_rejected`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_keyed_binding.py::test_a_forged_response_without_the_pair_key_is_rejected`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_keyed_binding.py::test_pinned_to_another_service_is_refused` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-20</span> | The response MAC covers the request's own X-SANDLOOM-RPC-Auth (and command signature), and a request carrying any auth/nonce/context/signature header twice is refused and never bound, so a provider's answer to a replayed or re-labelled request never verifies for another request. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_r1_a_response_cannot_be_rebound_to_another_request`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_r1_request_auth_covers_the_request_mac`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_keyed_binding.py::test_the_mac_covers_the_request_auth` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-21</span> | Responses are keyed with an HKDF pair key over each service's DEDICATED X25519 key (never its Ed25519 signing key, no custom curve code); the provider keys call, describe and error responses only for a caller whose request MAC verified, and answers others (e.g. the 413 body cap) with the nonce alone, unkeyed; unverified callers never churn the key cache. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_keyed_binding.py::test_no_custom_curve_code_and_no_signing_key_reuse`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_response_binding.py::test_provider_binds_call_describe_and_error_responses`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_response_binding.py::test_the_body_cap_413_echoes_the_nonce_unkeyed`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_binding_key_caches.py::test_unverified_or_unknown_callers_never_churn_the_pair_key_cache` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-22</span> | A response-binding rejection (other than an unkeyed refusal) discards the whole client connection pool and is a retryable transport error; a peer that always answers another call yields 503, never a result. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_response_binding.py::test_a_rejected_response_discards_the_connection_pool`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_response_binding.py::test_a_peer_that_always_answers_another_call_is_503_never_a_result`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_response_binding.py::test_concurrency_64_with_random_faults_never_returns_another_result` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-23</span> | The aiohttp and httpx transports are behaviourally identical: both raise httpx's exception classes, pass the same fault-injection, pair-MAC and contract-conformance suites, and send pair-MACed requests with the tenant context. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_transports.py::test_request_on_the_wire_is_pair_maced_with_tenant_context`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_parity.py::test_local_and_rpc_results_and_errors_are_identical`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_both_transports_authenticate_and_refuse_raw_replays`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_response_binding.py::test_httpx_transport_error_class_is_retryable` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-24</span> | A response larger than RPC_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES is 502 RemoteServiceBadResponse and is never retried. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_transports.py::test_oversized_response_is_502_and_not_retried` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-25</span> | The proxy retries a transport failure exactly once under a fresh nonce and tag (never seen as a replay; a signed command is re-signed and executes once), a second failure or an unreachable peer is 503, and a timeout is 503 documenting that the call may have committed. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_service_rpc.py::test_rpc_proxy_retries_transport_errors_under_a_fresh_nonce`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_transports.py::test_peer_closing_mid_response_twice_is_503`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_service_rpc.py::test_rpc_timeout_is_503_and_documents_maybe_committed`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_a_signed_command_survives_the_transport_retry` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-26</span> | A failing aiohttp internals probe or loopback self-test (unsolicited bytes on an idle connection) warns once, increments sandloom_rpc_transport_fallback_total and rebuilds the shared client on httpx, which serves calls; the pyproject pin equals VERIFIED_AIOHTTP_RANGE. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_transport_compat.py::test_a_failing_probe_warns_once_counts_and_falls_back_to_httpx`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_transport_compat.py::test_startup_probe_failure_rebuilds_the_shared_client_on_httpx`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_transport_compat.py::test_a_guard_that_no_longer_engages_is_caught_by_the_self_test`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_transport_compat.py::test_pyproject_pins_exactly_the_verified_range` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-27</span> | A pooled connection returns to the pool only after a complete keep-alive response: a timeout, cancellation, parse error or unsolicited byte closes it, so a half-read or stray response never reaches the next call. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_transports.py::test_unsolicited_bytes_never_reach_the_next_call`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_transports.py::test_cancellation_mid_call_discards_the_connection`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_transports.py::test_slow_peer_times_out_and_discards_the_connection`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_response_binding.py::test_cancellation_mid_read_never_leaks_the_late_answer` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-28</span> | No downgrade: an Ed25519-only request is 401 rpc_auth_required, a request with only X-Internal-Token or no credential gets the hidden 404 (INTERNAL_ENDPOINTS_OPEN_IN_DEV never opens /_sandloom/rpc), a bad MAC never falls back to a valid signature riding along, and a signed command stripped of its MAC is refused. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_downgrades_are_refused`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_service_rpc.py::test_rpc_server_hides_itself_from_a_request_without_credentials`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_contract_parity.py::test_open_dev_mode_does_not_open_rpc`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_r2_a_signed_command_cannot_be_stripped_of_its_mac` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-29</span> | The removed settings RPC_AUTH_MODE and RPC_RESPONSE_BINDING (like every config_tiers.REMOVED entry) fail startup unless set to their inert value (service_mac / strict), so no token or unkeyed mode can be re-enabled. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_config_tiers.py::test_removed_setting_fails_unless_inert` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-30</span> | Key rotation is per service and fails no call at any step: a provider accepts its current kid and RPC_DH_EXTRA_PRIVATE_KEYS kids (an unpublished extra kid is accepted but flagged), a dropped kid is refused, caller rotation needs no provider change, and the addressed kid is RPC_SERVICE_DH_CURRENT_KIDS or deterministic regardless of JSON order (an unpublished current kid is refused). | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_provider_rotation_has_no_failed_call_at_any_step`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_a_request_to_a_dropped_provider_kid_is_refused`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_keyed_binding.py::test_caller_key_rotation`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_security_review_regressions.py::test_pair_mac_key_selection_does_not_depend_on_json_order` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-31</span> | RPC rejections are logged with ids and kids only (never a key, tag or derived secret), rate-limited per reason and caller, and use a fixed, unique, declared reason vocabulary. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_rejections_log_ids_only_never_key_material`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_r6_rejection_logs_are_rate_limited`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_binding_reasons.py::test_every_reason_verify_emits_is_declared` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-32</span> | HEAD on the status route /_sandloom/rpc/<contract> is 405 (never served under a GET MAC). | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_pair_mac.py::test_head_on_the_status_route_is_not_served` |
| <span class="sl-id">G-RPC-33</span> | Describe and readiness probes are pair-MAC authenticated like calls and allowed when any method of the contract is allowed for the caller. | `sandloom/core/tests/test_rpc_allowlist.py::test_proxy_of_an_allowed_caller_calls_and_describes`<br>`sandloom/core/tests/test_split_readiness.py::test_required_probes_run_concurrently_capped_and_authenticated` |
